strapline.headline: Your room to grow. Your world of learning. IHG University.
strapline.intro: IHG University helps colleagues grow and develop leadership capability. Whether you're taking your next step or supporting your team's development, your journey starts here.

introBlock.internalComms: Room to Grow is IHG's commitment to helping colleagues develop and progress.
introBlock.ihgUniversityExplanation: IHG University is the place where colleagues build skills, develop leadership capability and prepare for their next step.
introBlock.journeyStartsHere: Whether you're growing your own career or developing your team, your journey starts here.

roles.label: Frontline colleague
roles.overview: Frontline colleagues deliver our guest experience every day—whether in rooms, food and beverage, or front desk. This is where many growth journeys start, with hands-on experience and pathways into supervision and beyond.
roles.quote: I started on the front desk. Room to Grow helped me see that my next step was within reach.

roles.label: Supervisor
roles.overview: Supervisors lead a small team or shift, supporting day-to-day operations and developing their first leadership skills. It's the first step into people leadership and a bridge to management.
roles.quote: Becoming a supervisor was the moment I realised I could grow without leaving what I love—hospitality.

roles.label: Manager
roles.overview: Managers lead a team or department, with responsibility for performance, development, and delivery. They balance operational excellence with people leadership and are key to developing the next generation of leaders.
roles.quote: As a manager, I'm not just running the department—I'm helping my team see their own routes to grow.

roles.label: Senior Manager
roles.overview: Senior managers lead larger teams or multiple areas, often with broader business or regional responsibility. They shape strategy, drive change, and develop other managers—a critical step toward general management.
roles.quote: The jump to senior manager was about thinking beyond my patch. Room to Grow showed me the programmes that got me there.

roles.label: General Manager
roles.overview: General Managers lead the property and its performance end to end—guest experience, commercial results, and team culture. They are the face of the hotel and set the tone for growth and development on site.
roles.quote: My role is to create a place where everyone can grow. IHG University and Room to Grow are how we make that real.

programmes.title: Journey to Supervisor
programmes.mapSummary: Prepares you for your first people-leadership step with practical, blended learning.
programmes.leadsTo: Your next role on the map: Supervisor.
programmes.whoItsFor: Frontline colleagues ready to step into a first leadership role.
programmes.skillsDeveloped: Delegation, team coordination, basic people management.
programmes.whatToExpect: Blended learning with practical application in your role.
programmes.nextStep: Discuss with your manager and enrol via IHG University.

programmes.title: Journey to Manager
programmes.mapSummary: Builds the management skills you need to lead a team or department with confidence.
programmes.leadsTo: Your next role on the map: Manager.
programmes.whatToExpect: Structured programme with workshops and on-the-job projects.
programmes.nextStep: Complete Journey to Supervisor and apply for Journey to Manager.

programmes.title: Journey to Senior Manager
programmes.mapSummary: Strengthens strategy, change and leading-managers capability for the tier above.
programmes.leadsTo: Your next role on the map: Senior Manager.
programmes.nextStep: Complete Journey to Manager and discuss with your GM.

programmes.title: Journey to General Manager
programmes.mapSummary: Executive-style development for property-wide leadership and commercial judgement.
programmes.leadsTo: Your next role on the map: General Manager.
programmes.whoItsFor: Senior managers ready for GM roles.
programmes.skillsDeveloped: P&L, property leadership, commercial and people strategy.
programmes.nextStep: Apply through your regional leadership team.

programmes.title: Core Leadership Learning
programmes.mapSummary: Bite-sized essentials you can stack alongside your day job—feedback, coaching, and more.
programmes.leadsTo: Stronger leadership practice in your current or next people-leading role.
programmes.whoItsFor: Anyone in or moving into a people-leading role.
programmes.timeCommitment: Ongoing; pick what fits your schedule.

programmes.title: Leadership Diplomas
programmes.mapSummary: Formal diploma-level leadership with assessment—ideal when you want recognised depth.
programmes.leadsTo: Accredited leadership credentials to support progression conversations.
programmes.whoItsFor: Managers and senior managers seeking formal recognition.
programmes.skillsDeveloped: Leadership theory and practice at diploma level.
programmes.nextStep: Check eligibility and apply via IHG University.

programmes.title: Foundational Diploma of Hospitality Leadership
programmes.mapSummary: Turn guest-facing experience into a recognised qualification alongside your journey.
programmes.leadsTo: Credentials and language for leadership that complement Journey programmes.
programmes.skillsDeveloped: Hospitality operations, customer service, team support.
programmes.nextStep: Enrol through your property or regional L&D contact.
programmes.whyChooseThis: Turn everyday guest-facing experience into a recognised qualification—so your next step is backed by credentials as well as confidence.
programmes.quote: I wanted something official on my CV, not just ‘I’ve done the job.’ The diploma gave me language for leadership and opened doors my manager and I hadn’t talked about yet.

programmes.title: Diploma of Hospitality Leadership
programmes.mapSummary: Deeper operational and leadership judgement for supervisors and managers.
programmes.leadsTo: Structured leadership skills matched to how hospitality actually runs.
programmes.nextStep: Complete Level 3 or meet entry requirements.
programmes.whyChooseThis: Go deeper than day-to-day tasks: build structured leadership judgement, stakeholder skills, and a pathway that matches how hospitality actually runs.
programmes.quote: Journey programmes got me started; the diploma is where I learned to think like a leader across the whole operation—not only my shift.

programmes.title: Advanced Diploma of Hospitality Leadership
programmes.mapSummary: Strategic and senior leadership development with a qualification that signals readiness.
programmes.leadsTo: Preparation for GM and regional scope—culture, pipeline, commercial acumen.
programmes.skillsDeveloped: Strategic and senior leadership in hospitality.
programmes.nextStep: Discuss with your GM or regional L&D.
programmes.whyChooseThis: Prepare for senior and general-management scope: strategy, commercial acumen, and developing other leaders—with a qualification that signals you’re ready.
programmes.quote: At senior manager level you’re expected to shape culture and pipeline, not just deliver results. The advanced diploma gave me frameworks I still use with my GMs and regional team.

stories.name: Maria
stories.shortStory: Maria started in Housekeeping and used Room to Grow to see her path to Supervisor, then Manager. She completed Journey to Supervisor and Journey to Manager and now leads her own team.

stories.name: James
stories.shortStory: James used the Growth Navigator to plan his route from frontline to Senior Manager. He combined leadership programmes with the Hospitality Diploma and is now developing future leaders.

faqs.question: How do I start?
faqs.answer: Use the Growth Navigator map to choose your current role, then tap Start learning now or Next step (your target role on the map) to see what fits you.

faqs.question: How long does learning take?
faqs.answer: It depends on the programme and how much time you can give. Most journeys are flexible and designed to fit around your role. Use the time filter to see options that match your availability.

faqs.question: Do I need my manager's support?
faqs.answer: We recommend discussing your goals with your manager. They can help you prioritise and align learning with your role. Many programmes include manager check-ins or sign-off.

faqs.question: How do I support my team?
faqs.answer: Select 'I'm developing my team' to see content tailored to leaders. You'll get guidance on how to support your team's growth, have development conversations, and use IHG University with your people.
